pages.text: Some brushes with monsters and enemies might make you rethink your strategies, I will recommend the following items which may aid in your battles and why:$(li)Vengeance Ring$()$(li)Waterpipe Shotgun$()$(li)A Shield$()$(li)Custom SMG$()

pages.title: Vengeance Ring
pages.text: Grants invisibility while active allowing for stealth, it does attract aggressive spirits and entices them to attach you, use a burning gemstone to remedy that

pages.title: Waterpipe Shotgun
pages.text: Projectile type spell casting device, deals a massive blow up close and even at moderate distances, perfect to get rid of nasty situations

pages.title: Shield
pages.text: A obvious one, you can obtain them in large quantities in dungeon towers

pages.title: Custom SMG
pages.text: Projectile type spell casting device, more well suited for dealing with mobs of enemies

There are also some more expensive but well worth items that can be made but delving into the Magic Schools. I am particularly fond of a well Enchanted SoulStained Scythe alongside the some acessories, it ends up being more powerful than a blast of bullets surprisingly, and while botanists enjoy their Terra blade it is a bit too expensive for my taste
